headline: 2006 order expands US asset freezes tied to the national emergency concerning Syria to cover more people.
what_it_does: This executive order adds more people to those whose property and assets in the United States can be frozen under an existing national emergency concerning Syria. Blocked property generally cannot be moved, sold, or used, and people in the US are generally barred from doing business with those named. The title does not say who the additional people are or why they were chosen.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations targeted under the order
who_it_affects.how: Their property and financial interests under US control can be frozen.
They generally must freeze assets of blocked persons and avoid transactions with them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 25, 2006; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
